nodes.name: minibox-core
nodes.description: Cross-platform shared types, domain traits, protocol, image ops. ~12.6k LOC.

nodes.name: minibox
nodes.description: Linux adapters, daemon handler/server/state, testing infra. ~21.5k LOC. Largest crate.

nodes.name: minibox-macros
nodes.description: Proc-macro crate: as_any!, adapt!, default_new!, provide!, test_run! ~300 LOC.

nodes.name: miniboxd
nodes.description: Daemon binary entry point, adapter DI composition root. ~1.6k LOC.

nodes.name: macbox
nodes.description: macOS daemon impl: colima and krun backends. ~3.6k LOC.

nodes.name: winbox
nodes.description: Windows stub. Returns error unconditionally. ~280 LOC.

nodes.name: mbx
nodes.description: CLI client binary. Connects via Unix socket, sends JSON requests. ~3.2k LOC.

nodes.name: minibox-crux-plugin
nodes.description: Crux plugin binary. Exposes minibox ops over JSON-RPC stdio for crux agentic DSL.

nodes.name: minibox-testsuite
nodes.description: Conformance test harness for adapter trait contracts.

nodes.name: xtask
nodes.description: Dev tool. CI gates, test runners, bench, VM image build. ~5k LOC.

nodes.name: DaemonRequest
nodes.description: 26 variants. Canonical in minibox-core/src/protocol.rs. JSON-over-newline on Unix socket.

nodes.name: DaemonResponse
nodes.description: 24 variants (17 terminal, 7 non-terminal streaming). Canonical in protocol.rs.

nodes.name: HandlerDependencies
nodes.description: DI container: ImageDeps, LifecycleDeps, ExecDeps, BuildDeps, EventDeps, policy, checkpoint.

nodes.name: ImageRegistry
nodes.description: Port: has_image, pull_image, get_image_layers. All adapter suites.

nodes.name: RegistryRouter
nodes.description: Port: route(hostname -> registry). All suites via HostnameRegistryRouter.

nodes.name: ImageLoader
nodes.description: Port: load_image (local tarball). native, gke, colima.

nodes.name: FilesystemProvider
nodes.description: Port: supertrait RootfsSetup + ChildInit. All suites.

nodes.name: ResourceLimiter
nodes.description: Port: create, add_process, cleanup. All suites (noop on gke/smolvm).

nodes.name: ContainerRuntime
nodes.description: Port: capabilities, spawn_process, wait_for_exit. All suites.

nodes.name: NetworkProvider
nodes.description: Port: setup, attach, cleanup, stats. native only (bridge/host/noop).

nodes.name: MetricsRecorder
nodes.description: Port: increment_counter, record_histogram, set_gauge.

nodes.name: ExecRuntime
nodes.description: Port: run_in_container. native only.

nodes.name: ImagePusher
nodes.description: Port: push_image. native, colima.

nodes.name: ContainerCommitter
nodes.description: Port: commit. native, colima.

nodes.name: ImageBuilder
nodes.description: Port: build_image. native, colima, smolvm.

nodes.name: VmCheckpoint
nodes.description: Port: save/restore/list snapshots. Noop everywhere.

nodes.name: PtyAllocator
nodes.description: Port: allocate. Internal exec path.

nodes.name: StateRepository
nodes.description: Port: load_containers, save_containers. JsonFileRepository (prod), in-memory (test).

nodes.name: native
nodes.description: Linux-only production suite. Full feature set: overlay, cgroups, namespaces, bridge network.

nodes.name: gke
nodes.description: Linux GKE pods. Copy FS, proot, noop limiter. No namespaces/cgroups.

nodes.name: colima
nodes.description: macOS/Linux via Lima VM. Delegates to nerdctl/limactl. Experimental.

nodes.name: smolvm
nodes.description: Default adapter. Lightweight Linux VMs, subsecond boot. Experimental.

nodes.name: krun
nodes.description: libkrun micro-VMs (HVF/KVM). Fallback when smolvm absent. 31 conformance tests.

nodes.name: DaemonState
nodes.description: Container metadata. Arc<RwLock<...>>. Persisted to JSON after every mutation. Atomic rename.

nodes.name: ContainerRecord
nodes.description: Per-container state: id, image, command, status, pid, step_state, priority, urgency, execution_context.

nodes.name: ContainerStatus
nodes.description: Created -> Running -> Stopped/Failed. Running -> Paused -> Running. Running(pid dead) -> Orphaned.

nodes.name: ExecutionManifest
nodes.description: Persisted before spawn. Captures image ref, layers, command, env digests, mounts, limits, network, privileged.

nodes.name: ExecutionPolicy
nodes.description: Admission gate: allowed/denied image patterns, network mode restrictions, privileged gate, mount allowlist.

nodes.name: slashcrux
nodes.description: Crux vocabulary types: Priority, Urgency, ExecutionContext, StepState. Used in protocol and state.

nodes.name: crux-plugin
nodes.description: Crux JSON-RPC plugin framework. Git dep used by minibox-crux-plugin.

nodes.name: validate_tar_entry_path
nodes.description: Rejects tar paths with .. components. Prevents Zip Slip. In layer.rs.

nodes.name: close_extra_fds
nodes.description: Closes FDs >2 before execve. Uses close_range(2) fast path. In process.rs.

nodes.name: SO_PEERCRED
nodes.description: Unix socket UID auth. Root-only when require_root_auth=true. In server.rs.

nodes.name: execve_not_execvp
nodes.description: Container init uses execve with explicit envp, never inherits daemon env.

nodes.name: setuid_strip
nodes.description: Strips setuid/setgid/sticky bits from extracted tar entries.

nodes.name: device_node_reject
nodes.description: Rejects Block/Char device nodes from tar extraction.

nodes.name: request_size_limit
nodes.description: MAX_REQUEST_SIZE=1MB. Prevents memory exhaustion from oversized JSON.

nodes.name: image_pull_limits
nodes.description: MAX_MANIFEST_SIZE=10MiB, MAX_LAYER_SIZE=10GiB, MAX_TOTAL_IMAGE_SIZE=50GiB.

nodes.name: container-lifecycle
nodes.description: CLI->Run->pull->overlay->spawn_blocking->clone(namespaces)->cgroup->pivot_root->execve->reaper.

nodes.name: stability-pipeline
nodes.description: Git branches: develop->next->staging->main->v* tag.
